name: GhostCommandPalette
description: Themed GhostCommandPalette root plus themed overlay and content wrappers that set data-themed, so the portaled palette picks up the scrim, elevation-4 surface, combobox input, and option recipes. Other parts are re-exported from @ghostvue/vue and styled through the content.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Palette parts composed by the consumer.

parts.name: input
parts.description: Query field with .ghost-command-palette-input and a focus ring.

parts.name: item
parts.description: Command row with .ghost-command-palette-item; the highlight draws the inset focus ring.

states.name: active
states.description: Highlighted item fill and inset focus ring.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-command-palette-list-max-size
cssProperties.description: Maximum block size of the scrolling list. Defaults to min(50dvh, 22rem).
